versions.changelog:
Initial release of content-writer-md skill.

- Drafts and formats Chinese self-media articles in Markdown or HTML based on user-approved material.
- Strictly uses only user-provided or approved sources—no browsing or outside research.
- Enforces a confirmation workflow: topic, outline, full user approval before drafting or file output.
- Clearly separates facts, opinions, and placeholders; ensures claims needing verification are marked.
- Markdown output is default; HTML available as preview.
- Forbids publishing, image generation, local file inspection, or configuration access.
